figurative_meaning_en: To act according to one's word; to keep one's promise
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার দেওয়া কথা থেকে যায়নি, সবাইকে সাহায্য করেছে।
তোমার কথা থাকলে এখনই চলে এসো।
example_sentences_in_english: He didn't let his word falter; he helped everyone as promised.
If your word stands, come right now.
note: This idiom emphasizes the cultural value of trustworthiness in Bengali society.
